drills.title: Adding points via namespace functions
hints: Structure Point, parameterised by α : Type u, with fields x and y of type α, deriving Repr.

Define Point.add on p q : Point Nat, building the result with the constructor mk (unqualified, since the definition lives in the Point namespace) from the sum of their x fields and the sum of their y fields.
Define p : Point Nat as the constructor applied to 1 and 2, and q : Point Nat as the constructor applied to 3 and 4.
Evaluate p added to q, calling add as a method on p.

drills.title: Extending a point with a color
hints: Structure Point, parameterised by α : Type u, with fields x and y of type α.
Inductive type Color with three argument-free constructors red, green, blue.
Structure ColorPoint, parameterised by α : Type u, that inherits from Point α and adds a field c : Color.

drills.title: Multiple inheritance with a proof field
hints: Structure Point, parameterised by α : Type u, with fields x, y, z of type α.
Structure RGBValue with Nat fields red, green, blue.
Structure RedGreenPoint, parameterised by α : Type u, inheriting from both Point α and RGBValue, adding a field no_blue stating blue = 0.
Define p : Point Nat as a structure instance with x 10, y 10, z 20.
Define rgp : RedGreenPoint Nat by updating p with red 200, green 40, blue 0, and no_blue proved by rfl.
Two anonymous examples, both proved by rfl: rgp's x field is 10, and rgp's red field is 200.
